scope: New continuous voice controller, voice UI, and dictation reconciliation; cumulative results from targeted runs

results.name: Voice starts only explicitly, guards simultaneous Start, and sends one greeting
Mute, Unmute, Interrupt and Stop control microphone, output and call teardown
Voice captions remain separate per item and repeated final events save each turn once
Microphone permission failure surfaces clearly without starting a paid call
Stop during pending microphone setup closes late tracks and creates no call
Stop during pending server setup tears down locally and closes the late created call
Cancelled setup blocks immediate restart until late session closes, then permits a fresh call
Background transition stops microphone and call without restarting
Server voice failure tears down tracks and peer with no automatic paid retry
Autoplay blocking shows a recovery action and manual audio enable recovers
UI: voice controls connect explicit Start, Mute, Interrupt and Stop actions
UI: rapid Start taps during conversation setup keep one active study conversation
UI: cancelled setup displays disabled Finishing voice setup and reenables Start after shutdown
UI: finalized voice captions POST unique turns once and update conversation bubbles
UI: autoplay failure exposes Enable speaker audio and the button restores playback
UI: permission and server failures show actionable status and restore typing without retry
UI: voice actions and captions fit a 360 by 800 phone without page overflow
Dictation: interim revisions and repeated final events replace the same index
Dictation: cumulative resultIndex updates append each segment once
Dictation: manual prefix and suffix edits survive revised speech, and corrected words stop dictation
Dictation: a new recording session appends its words once without replaying the previous session
Dictation: older stopped recognition callbacks cannot change a new session
Dictation: deliberate repeated words at distinct result indices are preserved
Dictation: browser removal of a trailing interim segment removes the stale text

resolvedDefects.name: Removed trailing interim dictation segment remained visible
resolvedDefects.reproduction: Result list length 2 with final + interim, then list shrinks to final only
resolvedDefects.fix: Delete result-index map entries outside the current results list
resolvedDefects.validation: Reran only previously failed removal group; passed

resolvedDefects.name: Rapid Start taps created two conversations
resolvedDefects.reproduction: Delay conversation creation 100 ms, click Start twice in the same task
resolvedDefects.fix: App-level lock covers conversation creation and voice setup
resolvedDefects.validation: Reran only previously failed rapid Start group; one conversation and one session

additionalReviewedFix.name: Cancelled pending voice setup could overlap a new Start
additionalReviewedFix.fix: setupPending guard and disabled Finishing voice setup state
additionalReviewedFix.validation: Two new targeted groups confirmed immediate restart blocked, late call closed, then fresh Start allowed

rerunPolicy: Previously passed groups were not repeated; only two failed groups were rerun after their fixes. New behavior received new focused checks.
limitations: Microphone, WebRTC, datachannel and speaker autoplay are browser fakes; no actual OpenAI calls.
Voice transcript POST responses are mocked in UI tests; server-side durability is a separate backend integration scope.
Physical phone microphone, audible quality, echo cancellation and real mobile background behavior require owner testing.
